summary: A throttled request that runs out of --timeout while waiting must still exit 7 (typed RateLimitedError); flags and MCP guidance this CLI cannot honor (run receipts without a platform source, cursor/limit paging) must be rejected or replaced, never silently ignored.
reason: OFA is an undocumented, per-IP-throttled backend with numbered 20-row pages and no platform source; generated defaults returned exit 5 on 429 wait timeouts, accepted --receipt as a no-op, and told MCP agents to page with after/limit, which OFA does not support.
validated_outcome: internal/client/ratelimit_timeout_test.go fails against the generated client and passes with the patch; 'breeds koolie --receipt' exits 2 with an explicit message.
